niche_profile.audience_summary: Print-on-demand designs for classroom teachers, selected school staff, educator self-purchases, and buyers giving appreciation or milestone gifts.

sources.note: Structured from the POD x AI x Idea Engine persona, occasion, emotion, product-fit, and market-fit framework.
Curated teacher gift and educator identity patterns; no live marketplace demand or trademark verification was performed.

assumptions: Primary commercial context is the US gift market.
Designs are intended for common POD apparel and gift products.
Seasonal dates and trademark status require live verification before launch.

emotions.name: Funny classroom chaos
emotions.job_to_be_done: Help educators recognize daily classroom pressure with affectionate insider humor.
emotions.design_direction: Short bold phrase, one classroom prop, and a controlled playful composition.
emotions.avoid: mocking students, cruelty, profanity, or burnout as the only identity

emotions.name: Warm appreciation
emotions.job_to_be_done: Help a buyer express sincere gratitude for a teacher's impact.
emotions.design_direction: Readable gratitude message with one or two meaningful education motifs.
emotions.avoid: long generic thank-you paragraphs or unsupported superlatives

emotions.name: Proud educator identity
emotions.job_to_be_done: Let educators display role, grade, subject, or career-stage pride.
emotions.design_direction: Role-first hierarchy, compact badge or statement layout, high thumbnail clarity.
emotions.avoid: broad teacher-life slogans with no subniche signal

emotions.name: Cozy bookish warmth
emotions.job_to_be_done: Connect literacy identity with a calm, giftable classroom mood.
emotions.design_direction: Books, soft stars, reading light, restrained warm palette, and clear type.
emotions.avoid: copied book quotes, book-cover art, or visual clutter

emotions.name: Premium retirement tribute
emotions.job_to_be_done: Honor a long teaching career with dignity and personalization.
emotions.design_direction: Refined serif hierarchy, subtle floral or book motif, name and year emphasis.
emotions.avoid: juvenile icons, age jokes, and excessive distressed effects

emotions.name: Cute playful classroom
emotions.job_to_be_done: Express approachable early-learning energy without losing readability.
emotions.design_direction: Rounded lettering, simple smiling objects if original, stars, crayons, and limited colors.
emotions.avoid: licensed characters, babyish treatment, or too many tiny decorations

emotions.name: Calm supportive presence
emotions.job_to_be_done: Recognize school-support roles through trust, listening, and reassurance.
emotions.design_direction: Clean modern composition with soft shapes, speech or pathway motifs, and generous spacing.
emotions.avoid: medical promises, diagnostic labels, and savior narratives

buyer_language.meaning: Buyers value a teacher's influence beyond daily instruction.
buyer_language.avoid: claiming measurable outcomes the buyer did not provide

buyer_language.meaning: Early-childhood buyers respond to the contrast between small children and meaningful work.
buyer_language.avoid: using child-focused language for secondary or adult educators

buyer_language.meaning: Educators recognize unpredictable classroom routines and shared coping rituals.
buyer_language.avoid: demeaning students, glorifying exhaustion, or copying known slogans

buyer_language.meaning: New teachers want identity markers for an earned career milestone.
Retirement buyers emphasize contribution, memory, and a transition into a new stage.
buyer_language.avoid: invented service dates or age-based jokes

buyer_language.meaning: Subject teachers prefer specific language over a broad teacher label.
buyer_language.avoid: incorrect formulas, copied puns, or trademarked program names

buyer_language.meaning: Support-role gifts value trust and emotional availability.
buyer_language.avoid: therapy claims or guaranteed wellbeing outcomes

buyer_language.meaning: Family buyers want both identities recognized in one personal gift.
buyer_language.avoid: assuming parenthood or adding names without explicit input

palettes.name: classroom primary
palettes.use_when: elementary, playful, and high-energy classroom concepts
palettes.contrast_rule: Use dark outlines and keep all artwork colors visually distant from #00FF00.

palettes.name: warm retro classroom
palettes.use_when: retro apparel, subject pride, and cozy self-purchase designs
palettes.contrast_rule: Use cream or dark contours; replace bright green with muted olive.

palettes.name: premium appreciation
palettes.use_when: retirement, formal appreciation, and premium gifts
palettes.contrast_rule: Keep gold and cream details thick enough for print; no neon accents.

palettes.name: calm support
palettes.use_when: school counselor and inclusive support concepts
palettes.contrast_rule: Use deep teal rather than bright green to preserve chroma separation.

typography.name: friendly bold sans
typography.direction: rounded, heavy, and readable at thumbnail size
typography.avoid: thin counters, bubble letters with malformed text, and phrases over 12 words

typography.name: collegiate slab
typography.direction: strong role-first lettering with restrained retro treatment
typography.use_when: subject pride, first year, and badge concepts
typography.avoid: official university resemblance and excessive distress

typography.name: refined serif
typography.direction: high-contrast but print-safe serif paired with a clean small sans
typography.use_when: retirement, premium appreciation, and personalized tributes
typography.avoid: hairline strokes and ornate scripts for long names

typography.name: clean humanist sans
typography.direction: calm, balanced, and accessible with generous spacing
typography.use_when: school counselor, special education, and modern minimal concepts
typography.avoid: clinical visual tone and low contrast

compositions.name: central-statement
compositions.hierarchy: main hook first, role or subject second, one motif cluster last
compositions.avoid: more than three competing focal points

compositions.name: arched-role-badge
compositions.hierarchy: role or grade on top arc, central symbol, short supporting line below
compositions.use_when: identity, subject pride, and series designs
compositions.avoid: copying official seals or school badges

compositions.name: personalized-keepsake
compositions.hierarchy: recipient name first, milestone message second, year or class detail last
compositions.use_when: retirement, ornament, blanket, and graduation gifts
compositions.avoid: unvalidated long names and dense student lists

compositions.name: minimal-symbol-line
compositions.hierarchy: short phrase, one small symbolic mark, generous negative space
compositions.use_when: premium mugs, counselor gifts, and modern totes
compositions.avoid: thin lines and tiny secondary copy

product_fit.print_notes: Use a strong central hierarchy and thick strokes for front-chest printing.
Use a compact medium-to-large composition with robust lettering.
Keep primary copy large and avoid details that become tiny on a wrap area.
Use a tall central design with bold contours and enough spacing around handles and seams.
Prioritize name and year; simplify motifs for a small circular or shaped print area.
Use large type and grouped personalization that remains legible at viewing distance.
Use deliberate spacing and a clear reading order; retain print-safe margins.
avoid: casual jokes for formal tribute contexts

product_fit.print_notes: Use a closed silhouette, thick outline, and minimal text.

personalization_fields.label: Teacher name
personalization_fields.validation: 1-24 visible characters; preserve supplied capitalization; no emoji

personalization_fields.label: Grade level
personalization_fields.validation: Use a recognized grade label supplied by the buyer; maximum 20 characters

personalization_fields.label: Subject taught
personalization_fields.validation: 1-20 characters; verify spelling and intended capitalization

personalization_fields.label: School year
personalization_fields.validation: Accept YYYY or YYYY-YYYY; confirm dash format before production

personalization_fields.label: Class name
personalization_fields.validation: 1-24 characters; do not add a school name unless rights and intent are confirmed

personalization_fields.label: Retirement year
personalization_fields.validation: Four-digit year supplied by the buyer

personalization_fields.label: Years taught
personalization_fields.validation: Positive whole number supplied by the buyer; never infer from dates

personalization_fields.label: Student names
personalization_fields.validation: Require final approved spelling; apply product-specific name-count limit

personalization_fields.label: Children's names
personalization_fields.validation: Require explicit buyer input and final spelling approval

personalization_fields.label: School role title
personalization_fields.validation: Use the exact role supplied by the buyer; maximum 28 characters

personalization_fields.label: Graduation year
personalization_fields.validation: Four-digit year; do not add institution or credential without confirmation

Growing Readers, One Chapter at a Time

hook_patterns.avoid: invented years, age jokes, or unsupported claims

hook_patterns.avoid: assuming parent status without explicit buyer context

style_variants.label: Bold typographic / retro
style_variants.commercial_role: maximize thumbnail clarity and role recognition
style_variants.description: Large role-first phrase with restrained retro treatment and two small classroom accents.
style_variants.typography: collegiate slab or heavy serif paired with a compact sans
style_variants.avoid: heavy distress, official school styling, and more than two supporting motifs

style_variants.label: Cute playful illustrated
style_variants.commercial_role: create approachable early-learning and casual gift appeal
style_variants.description: Rounded lettering with original simple classroom objects, stars, and a controlled playful rhythm.
style_variants.typography: friendly bold sans with one short handwritten-style accent
style_variants.avoid: licensed characters, babyish teacher portrayal, and tiny decorative clutter

style_variants.label: Minimal premium / clean modern
style_variants.commercial_role: support premium gifts and professional role recognition
style_variants.description: One concise phrase, one meaningful symbol, generous spacing, and a polished hierarchy.
style_variants.typography: refined serif or clean humanist sans
style_variants.avoid: hairline strokes, low contrast, decorative filler, and long copy

style_variants.label: Badge / emblem / sentimental keepsake
style_variants.commercial_role: support personalization, milestones, and expandable series
style_variants.description: Original non-official emblem with role, central motif, recipient name, and year or milestone detail.
style_variants.typography: collegiate slab for role plus refined serif or clean sans for personalization
style_variants.avoid: school-seal resemblance, official crests, cramped text, and unverified dates

niche_specific_avoid: university names and branded graduation marks
licensed children's book or movie characters
copied classroom clipart and competitor layouts
song lyrics and long book quotations
brand names for supplies, coffee, or technology
trademarked education programs and certification names
real school, district, or institution names without owner confirmation

safe_substitutions.replace_with: generic schoolhouse, pencil, book, star, or original non-official emblem
original open-book, bookmark, reading lamp, or abstract literacy motif
generic pencil, crayon, planner, mug, or classroom tool
new concise phrase built from the same broad emotion and buyer intent
role, grade, subject, recipient name, and year supplied by the buyer

human_review_triggers: any school, district, university, or institution name
a phrase presented as a known slogan
a reference image from a competitor listing
a certification, program, or curriculum name
a requested quote from a song, book, movie, or public figure

qa_rules.min_text_legibility: Main phrase remains readable at a 300 px thumbnail and personalized text remains readable at intended product size.
qa_rules.background_edge_rule: Final delivery edges must be transparent; a solid fallback is only a temporary removal canvas.

sample_briefs.title: Kindergarten teacher appreciation sweatshirt
sample_briefs.visual_direction: Bold rounded phrase with crayon stars, one pencil, and a simple original rainbow.
sample_briefs.why_it_fits: The concept connects a clear parent-to-teacher gift occasion with an early-learning phrase and sweatshirt-safe hierarchy.
sample_briefs.ip_notes: Use only generic classroom motifs and original lettering.

sample_briefs.title: First-year teacher milestone mug
sample_briefs.visual_direction: Large role-first typography with one pencil, a small coffee cup, and restrained stars.
sample_briefs.why_it_fits: The phrase marks a specific career stage and remains short enough for a mug.
sample_briefs.ip_notes: Do not add a school, university, or certification mark.

sample_briefs.title: Personalized retired teacher blanket
sample_briefs.visual_direction: Original open-book emblem with subtle florals, recipient name, retirement year, and strong central typography.
sample_briefs.why_it_fits: A blanket supports a sentimental message and larger personalization while matching a team tribute purchase.
sample_briefs.ip_notes: Require buyer confirmation for every year and avoid school seals.

sample_briefs.title: Cozy reading teacher tote
sample_briefs.visual_direction: Open book and bookmark beneath clean readable text with restrained warm accents.
sample_briefs.why_it_fits: The concept speaks to literacy identity and uses a vertical tote-friendly composition.
sample_briefs.ip_notes: Use original text and no book-cover or character references.

sample_briefs.why_it_fits: The message recognizes a specific support job without making a medical claim.
sample_briefs.ip_notes: Avoid therapy promises, diagnostic terms, and official school marks.

sample_briefs.why_it_fits: The buyer-recipient relationship and dual identity create a personal reason to purchase.

output_notes: Verify the current listing-image and production-partner requirements before launch.
Keep design copy concise, original, and appropriate for a gift marketplace.
Treat theme, app, and printer specifications as store-specific inputs.
Do not infer a marketplace canvas size without the active storefront template.
Verify the exact active Amazon program and product template before export.
Avoid unsupported superlatives, institutional affiliation, and certification claims.

evidence_claims.statement: Teacher appreciation, career milestones, and educator identity are plausible POD gift angles.
Grade, subject, career stage, classroom role, and recipient relationship can make teacher copy more specific.
Appreciation, back-to-school, end-of-year, graduation, and retirement timing may change buyer intent and lead time.

constraints: Replace named licensed characters or brands with original generic motifs and new wording. Do not infer legal clearance from a non-match.
